name: Raffaele Colosimo
bioAdditions: Raffaele was baptized on 27 August 1821, son of Luigi Colosimo and Carmela Moraca (S1). He married Filippina Iera on 24 March 1839, aged only 17 (S2). They had at least ten children between 1840 and 1866, including John's ancestor Saveria (1848) (S5). Filippina died in 1871. In October 1872 Raffaele remarried Maria Luigia Rametta (indexed as Barretta at a son's 1873 baptism) (S3, S5). He was buried at San Mango on 18 January 1899 (S4). The burial gives his age as 89, but by his baptism he was 77.

relationships.evidence: Baptism and 2nd marriage name father Luigi

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism, two marriages and burial indexed; daughter Saveria's baptism and marriage name him.
